tool_schemas.name: list_work_items
tool_schemas.description: Lists locally mirrored work items for the given project, optionally filtered by status, type, assignee, tag, and source, and returns a sorted page of results with an opaque cursor for pagination (pass cursor to fetch the next page; limit controls page size). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if project_id is not a valid azdo_prj_ ULID, if limit is out of range, or if any enum parameter is not one of the allowed values. Raises NOT_FOUND if the project does not exist or is not accessible, and raises FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to read work items for that project.

project_id.description: Local project id (ULID) to list work items for.

status.description: Filter by work item lifecycle status.

work_item_type.description: Filter by Azure DevOps work item type (e.g., Bug, Task, User Story).

assigned_to.description: Filter by assignee display name or identifier as stored locally.

tag.description: Filter to items containing a specific tag.

source.description: Filter by origin of the record.

limit.description: Maximum number of work items to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: get_work_item
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single locally mirrored work item by its local azdo_wi_ ULID and returns its stored fields and lifecycle status. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if work_item_id is not a valid azdo_wi_ ULID. Raises NOT_FOUND if the work item does not exist or is not accessible, and raises FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to view it.

work_item_id.description: Local work item id (ULID) to retrieve.

tool_schemas.name: create_work_item
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new work item in the specified local project and returns the created work item record with its local id, requested fields (type/title/description/etc.), and initial lifecycle status. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing, project_id is not a valid azdo_prj_ ULID, status is not one of the allowed values, or tags is not an array of strings. Raises NOT_FOUND if the project does not exist or is not accessible, FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to create work items in the project, and CONFLICT if the request attempts an unsupported or invalid initial lifecycle status for creation.

project_id.description: Local project id (ULID) to create the work item in.

work_item_type.description: Azure DevOps work item type to create (e.g., Bug, Task, User Story).

assigned_to.description: Assignee display name or identifier to set on the work item.

status.description: Initial status to set for the work item.

area_path.description: Area path to set on the work item.

iteration_path.description: Iteration/sprint path to set on the work item.

tags.description: List of tags to apply to the work item.

tool_schemas.name: list_pull_requests
tool_schemas.description: Lists locally mirrored pull requests for the given project and Azure DevOps repository, optionally filtered by status, creator, and branch names, and returns a sorted page of results with an opaque cursor for pagination (pass cursor to fetch the next page; limit controls page size). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if project_id is not a valid azdo_prj_ ULID, if limit is out of range, or if any enum parameter is not one of the allowed values. Raises NOT_FOUND if the project or repository is unknown/not accessible, and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to read pull requests for the repository.

project_id.description: Local project id (ULID) containing the repository.

repository_id.description: Azure DevOps repository id to list pull requests for.

created_by.description: Filter by PR creator as stored locally.

limit.description: Maximum number of pull requests to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: get_pull_request
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single locally mirrored pull request by its local azdo_pr_ ULID and returns its stored metadata and lifecycle status. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if pull_request_id is not a valid azdo_pr_ ULID. Raises NOT_FOUND if the pull request does not exist or is not accessible, and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to view it.

pull_request_id.description: Local pull request id (ULID) to retrieve.

tool_schemas.name: create_pull_request
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new pull request in the specified project and Azure DevOps repository using the provided title, sourceBranch, and targetBranch, optionally marking it as a draft and linking Azure DevOps work item numeric IDs, and returns the created pull request record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing, project_id is not a valid azdo_prj_ ULID, or workItemIds is not an array of integers. Raises NOT_FOUND if the project or repository is unknown/not accessible, FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to create pull requests in the repository, and CONFLICT if the pull request cannot be created due to an invalid or unsupported state/request (for example, incompatible draft/status expectations).

project_id.description: Local project id (ULID) to create the pull request in.

repository_id.description: Azure DevOps repository id to create the pull request in.

sourceBranch.description: Source branch name for the pull request.

targetBranch.description: Target branch name for the pull request.

isDraft.description: Whether to create the pull request as a draft.

workItemIds.description: Azure DevOps work item numeric ids to link to the pull request.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def create_pull_request(project_id, repository_id, title, description=None, sourceBranch=None, targetBranch=None, isDraft=None, workItemIds=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, re, time, random
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0445000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0445000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    endpoint = "create_pull_request"
    def _log(status, credential_id=None, error_code=None):
        try:
            logs = _load("request_logs.json")
            if not isinstance(logs, list): logs = []
            logs.append({
                "id": f"req_{int(time.time()*1000)}_{os.getpid()}_{len(logs)+1}",
                "endpoint": endpoint,
                "credential_id": credential_id,
                "status": status,
                "error_code": error_code,
                "latency_ms": int((time.time()-t0)*1000),
                "timestamp": datetime.datetime.utcnow().isoformat() + "Z",
            })
            _save("request_logs.json", logs)
        except Exception:
            pass

    def _ulid_like(prefix):
        alphabet = "0123456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ"
        # not a true ULID, but matches required pattern prefix + base32 length>=10
        return prefix + "".join(random.choice(alphabet) for _ in range(16))

    try:
        if not isinstance(project_id, str) or not re.match(r"^azdo_prj_[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{10,}$", project_id):
            res = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "project_id is not a valid azdo_prj_ ULID", field="project_id")
            _log("error", error_code=res["error"]["code"])
            return res
        if not isinstance(repository_id, str) or repository_id.strip() == "":
            res = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "repository_id is required and must be a non-empty string", field="repository_id")
            _log("error", error_code=res["error"]["code"])
            return res
        if not isinstance(title, str) or title.strip() == "":
            res = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "title is required and must be a non-empty string", field="title")
            _log("error", error_code=res["error"]["code"])
            return res
        if sourceBranch is None or not isinstance(sourceBranch, str) or sourceBranch.strip() == "":
            res = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "sourceBranch is required and must be a non-empty string", field="sourceBranch")
            _log("error", error_code=res["error"]["code"])
            return res
        if targetBranch is None or not isinstance(targetBranch, str) or targetBranch.strip() == "":
            res = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "targetBranch is required and must be a non-empty string", field="targetBranch")
            _log("error", error_code=res["error"]["code"])
            return res
        if description is not None and not isinstance(description, str):
            res = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "description must be a string when provided", field="description")
            _log("error", error_code=res["error"]["code"])
            return res
        # Business rule / schema constraint: description <> '' (required by create_pull_request surface description)
        if description is None or (isinstance(description, str) and description.strip() == ""):
            res = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "description is required and must be non-empty", field="description")
            _log("error", error_code=res["error"]["code"])
            return res
        if isDraft is not None and not isinstance(isDraft, bool):
            res = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "isDraft must be boolean when provided", field="isDraft")
            _log("error", error_code=res["error"]["code"])
            return res
        if workItemIds is not None:
            if not isinstance(workItemIds, list):
                res = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "workItemIds must be an array of integers when provided", field="workItemIds")
                _log("error", error_code=res["error"]["code"])
                return res
            for i, v in enumerate(workItemIds):
                if not isinstance(v, int):
                    res = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "workItemIds must contain only integers", field="workItemIds", index=i)
                    _log("error", error_code=res["error"]["code"])
                    return res

        projects = _load("projects.json")
        if not isinstance(projects, list): projects = []
        project = next((p for p in projects if p.get("id") == project_id), None)
        if not project:
            res = _err("NOT_FOUND", "Project not found", field="project_id")
            _log("error", error_code=res["error"]["code"])
            return res
        if project.get("state") in ("deleted", "deleting"):
            res = _err("INVALID_TRANSITION", "Cannot create pull request in a project that is deleting/deleted", project_state=project.get("state"))
            _log("error", error_code=res["error"]["code"])
            return res

        # Validate work item references when locally known: each numeric id must exist in same project if present locally.
        external_refs = []
        if workItemIds:
            wis = _load("work_items.json")
            if not isinstance(wis, list): wis = []
            by_ado = {}
            for wi in wis:
                if wi.get("project_id") == project_id and isinstance(wi.get("ado_work_item_id"), int):
                    by_ado[wi["ado_work_item_id"]] = wi
            for wid in workItemIds:
                if wid in by_ado:
                    # ok
                    continue
                else:
                    external_refs.append(wid)

        prs = _load("pull_requests.json")
        if not isinstance(prs, list): prs = []
        now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().isoformat() + "Z"

        pr_id = _ulid_like("azdo_pr_")
        # ensure unique
        existing_ids = {r.get("id") for r in prs if isinstance(r, dict)}
        while pr_id in existing_ids:
            pr_id = _ulid_like("azdo_pr_")

        status = "draft" if isDraft else "active"
        row = {
            "id": pr_id,
            "project_id": project_id,
            "repository_id": repository_id,
            "ado_pull_request_id": None,
            "title": title,
            "description": description,
            "source_branch": sourceBranch,
            "target_branch": targetBranch,
            "created_by": None,
            "status": status,
            "is_draft": bool(isDraft) if isDraft is not None else False,
            "merge_status": None,
            "work_item_ids": workItemIds if workItemIds is not None else None,
            "last_diff_etag": None,
            "last_diff_cached_at": None,
            "last_synced_at": None,
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now,
        }

        # Schema constraint: is_draft = true implies status in ('draft','active') satisfied.
        # Unique(project_id, repository_id, ado_pull_request_id) with ado_pull_request_id null: treat as allowed (vendor DB likely allows multiple NULLs).
        prs.append(row)
        _save("pull_requests.json", prs)

        resp = {"pull_request": row}
        if external_refs:
            resp["warnings"] = [{
                "code": "EXTERNAL_REFERENCE",
                "message": "Some workItemIds are not present locally; treated as external references.",
                "work_item_ids": external_refs
            }]

        _log("ok")
        return resp
    except Exception as e:
        res = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Unexpected error", detail=str(e))
        _log("error", error_code=res["error"]["code"])
        return res

tool_schemas.name: create_pull_request_comment
tool_schemas.description: Adds a comment to a locally mirrored pull request and returns the created comment (and thread association when applicable); if ado_thread_id is provided, the comment is appended to that existing Azure DevOps thread, otherwise a new thread is created. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if pull_request_id is not a valid azdo_pr_ ULID, content is empty/invalid, or ado_thread_id is not an integer when provided. Raises NOT_FOUND if the pull request does not exist or the specified thread id is not present for that pull request, FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to comment, and CONFLICT if the pull request is in a state that does not accept new comments.

pull_request_id.description: Local pull request id (ULID) to comment on.

ado_thread_id.description: Existing Azure DevOps thread id to add the comment to.

tool_schemas.name: get_pull_request_diff
tool_schemas.description: Returns the stored diff for a locally mirrored pull request; when etag is provided, the diff is returned conditionally and may be omitted when the etag matches the current diff version. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if pull_request_id is not a valid azdo_pr_ ULID. Raises NOT_FOUND if the pull request or its diff is not available locally, and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to view the pull request diff.

pull_request_id.description: Local pull request id (ULID) to fetch the diff for.

etag.description: Optional ETag to enable conditional diff retrieval/caching.

tool_schemas.name: update_pull_request
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields on an existing locally mirrored pull request (title/description/status/draft flag/work item links) and returns the updated pull request record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if pull_request_id is not a valid azdo_pr_ ULID, if status is not one of the allowed values, or if work_item_ids is not an array of integers. Raises NOT_FOUND if the pull request does not exist or is not accessible, FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to update it, and CONFLICT if the requested lifecycle transition is not allowed (for example, attempting to move to an incompatible status or change draft settings in a way the current state refuses).

pull_request_id.description: Local pull request ULID (pull_requests.id) to update.

is_draft.description: Whether the pull request is marked as a draft.

work_item_ids.description: Azure DevOps work item numeric IDs to associate with the pull request.

tool_schemas.name: create_wiki_page
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new wiki page under the specified Azure DevOps wiki and path for the given project, storing the provided title and Markdown content, and returns the created page record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if project_id is not a valid azdo_prj_ ULID, required fields are missing, or path/title/content_markdown are invalid. Raises NOT_FOUND if the project or wiki_id is unknown/not accessible, FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to create wiki pages, and CONFLICT if a page already exists at the requested path.

project_id.description: Local project ULID (projects.id) that owns the wiki page.

wiki_id.description: Azure DevOps wiki identifier where the page will be created.

tool_schemas.name: edit_wiki_page
tool_schemas.description: Updates a locally mirrored Azure DevOps wiki page by ID, applying any provided changes to title, Markdown content, and/or path, and returns the updated wiki page record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if wiki_page_id is malformed, if no editable fields are provided, or if ado_version is not a valid integer; raises NOT_FOUND if the wiki page does not exist. Raises CONFLICT if ado_version is provided and does not match the current stored Azure DevOps version (optimistic concurrency), and raises FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to edit the page.

wiki_page_id.description: Local wiki page ULID (wiki_pages.id) to edit.

content_markdown.description: Updated wiki page content in Markdown.

path.description: Updated wiki page path (renames/moves the page).

ado_version.description: Expected Azure DevOps wiki page version for optimistic concurrency.

tool_schemas.name: list_projects
tool_schemas.description: Lists locally mirrored projects accessible in the organization, applying optional filters (organization, visibility, state, search) and sorting, and returns a paged result set ordered by sort_by/sort_order. Pagination is cursor-based: the response returns up to limit items and a next_cursor when more results are available; pass cursor to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid enum values, out-of-range limit, or an unrecognized cursor, and raises FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to list projects for the requested organization.

organization.description: Azure DevOps organization name/slug to scope results.

search.description: Case-insensitive substring match against project name.

limit.description: Maximum number of projects to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: get_project
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single locally mirrored Azure DevOps project by its project_id and returns the full project record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if project_id does not match the expected ULID format. Raises NOT_FOUND if no project exists with that ID, and raises FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to view it.

tool_schemas.name: update_work_item
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields on a locally mirrored work item and returns the updated record. Status changes must follow the work_item lifecycle transitions (new→active/removed, active→resolved/closed/removed, resolved→active/closed, closed→active). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if the work_item_id is invalid, if no fields are provided, or if a requested status transition is not allowed. Raises NOT_FOUND if the work item does not exist, and raises FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to modify it.

work_item_id.description: Local work item id (ULID) to update.

title.description: New title for the work item.

description.description: New description/body for the work item.

assigned_to.description: Assignee display name or identifier to set on the work item.

status.description: New lifecycle status to set; must follow allowed transitions.

area_path.description: Area path to set on the work item.

iteration_path.description: Iteration/sprint path to set on the work item.

tags.description: Full replacement list of tags to apply to the work item.

tool_schemas.name: get_identity
tool_schemas.description: Returns the calling identity as recognized by this integration, including granted scopes and current quota/rate-limit consumption. Raises UNAUTHENTICATED if no valid credential is presented, and raises FORBIDDEN if the credential is valid but not entitled to use this integration.

ado_pat.description: Azure DevOps Personal Access Token used to authenticate; if omitted, the server will use the credential configured for the integration if available.

metadata.name: Azure DevOps Integration
metadata.description: This backend models an Azure DevOps organization integration that mirrors key Azure DevOps entities (projects, work items, pull requests, and wiki pages) locally for fast listing, retrieval, and mutation via API tools. Workflows include syncing projects, creating/updating work items and pull request
